## Operating Model (Hive Doctrine -- non-negotiable)

1. **Parallel dispatch by default.** Non-trivial tasks fan out to 3+ agents in one
   pass. Independent lanes never run serially.
2. **Plan first, second-opinion always.** No edits until a plan exists and a second
   AI has reviewed it.
3. **Live data via MCP.** Never paste a screenshot when the data is pullable. MCP
   fleet runs at 127.0.0.1:3101-3107 (blinko, market-intel, n8n, broker-os, supabase,
   stripe, resend).
4. **Recurring work becomes a command.** If you ran it twice, it goes in
   `commands/`. If you ran it on a schedule, it goes in `cron`.
5. **Subagents for every sub-task.** Don't solo what you can fan out.
6. **MCP is the auth + logging boundary.** No raw API keys outside the MCP layer.
7. **Hive-wide fan-out on stakes > $100.** Seven-mind triangulation, Lucrex
   resolves disagreements.
8. **Verify against source of truth.** No "should be" or "I think." Hit the API,
   read the file, query the DB. Failures lead the report, greens follow.
9. **Find broken, fix broken.** An audit that names N problems launches N fix
   dispatches in the same turn. Identification is a trigger, not an endpoint.
10. **All hands at all times.** Independent lanes get parallel dispatch. Bounded
    only by the credit budget.
